items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: I believe Mipolite Charles was playing the trumpet at the time.

ctx.x: Who else was in the Silverleaf band who played trumpet?
I believe Mipolite Charles was playing the trumpet at the time. That's right. And Mr. Baptiste, Albert Baptiste was the leader. Who did he play? He played violin.
